WITH income_by_dept AS (
    SELECT 
        ma.department,
        COUNT(i.income_id) as income_count
    FROM income i
    JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
    JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
    GROUP BY ma.department
),
dept_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        department,
        income_count,
        (income_count * 1.0) / SUM(income_count) OVER () as share,
        AVG((income_count * 1.0) / SUM(income_count) OVER ()) OVER () as avg_share
    FROM income_by_dept
),
above_avg_depts AS (
    SELECT 
        income_count,
        share,
        avg_share
    FROM dept_shares
    WHERE share > avg_share
)
SELECT 
    SUM(income_count) as combined_count,
    AVG(share) as average_share,
    AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_amount_above_avg
FROM above_avg_depts;
